description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy' for a module that cleans up poorly written HTML by applying various fixes at different levels. It includes methods for setup, retrieving fixes based on levels, populating fixes, and parsing fix names.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy
classes.description: An abstract class for a module that tidies HTML by applying fixes at different levels.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by creating fixes, determining which to apply based on configuration, and populating the module with fixes.

methods.name: getFixesForLevel
methods.description: Returns a lookup table of fixes applicable for a specified level, including all levels below it.

methods.name: makeFixesForLevel
methods.description: Populates the fixesForLevel array based on a provided fixes array, considering the default level.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the module with fixes by interpreting fix names and applying them to the module's configuration.

methods.name: getFixType
methods.description: Parses a fix name to determine its type and parameters.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Abstract method to define all fixes the module will perform.
